### The Lion's Diverse Excellencies
Author: Erik Raymond
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/erik-raymond/15860/
Passage: Joel 3:14-16
Points:
- The gathering in the valley is a solemn assembly for divine reckoning rather than celebration.
- God roars with sovereign authority as King, shaking heaven and earth before His enemies.
- The same Lord who executes judgment acts as an impenetrable stronghold for His people.
- God displays diverse excellencies, functioning simultaneously as Judge and Savior.
- Sinners can find no escape from God until they seek refuge in Him.

### Responsibility
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/day-by-day-oct-12-2010-11639390.html
Passage: Joel 3:14
Points:
- Authentic liberty always requires people to shoulder the weight of responsibility.
- Worthwhile goals are achieved by active doers rather than passive bystanders.
- Chronic hesitation leaves a person paralyzed and barren of real accomplishment.
- Embracing maturity requires the courage to make tough, decisive choices.
